title: auth_login_correct_credentials
description: EXACT STEPS: 1) POST {"Correo":"admin@gmail.com","Contrasena":"Admin123*"} to /api/Auth/login. 2) Assert status==200. 3) Assert keys in response JSON: 'token'(non-empty string), 'username'(string), 'correo'(string), 'fotoPerfilUrl'(string-or-null). WARNING: field is 'correo' NOT 'email'. Assert EXACTLY: 'token' in data, 'username' in data, 'correo' in data, 'fotoPerfilUrl' in data.

title: auth_login_incorrect_password
description: POST {"Correo":"admin@gmail.com","Contrasena":"wrong"} to /api/Auth/login. Assert status==401.

title: auth_register_new_user
description: POST to /api/Auth/register. BODY MUST HAVE EXACTLY: {"Correo":"unique@test.com","Contrasena":"Test123*","UserName":"unique_user"}. ALL 3 FIELDS REQUIRED. Do NOT add other fields. Assert status==200.

title: catalog_get_all_books
description: GET /api/Libro. Assert status==200, response is list with >0 items. Each item has lowercase keys: id, titulo, autor, descripcion, portadaUrl, archivoUrl, esPublico, fechaCreacion, usuarioCreadorId, promedioValoracion, totalValoraciones, categorias(array).

title: catalog_search_paged
description: GET /api/Libro/paged?page=1&pageSize=10. Assert status==200. Response has lowercase keys: 'page','pageSize','total','totalPages','data'(array). Each item in data has: id,titulo,autor,descripcion(not sinopsis),categorias(array,not string),portadaUrl,archivoUrl,esPublico,promedioValoracion,totalValoraciones.

title: categories_list_paged
description: GET /api/Categorias. Assert status==200. Response has: 'results'(array),'totalRecords','pageSize','currentPage'. Each result item has lowercase keys: id,nombre,totalLibros. No 'descripcion' in items.

title: category_create_and_get
description: POST {"nombre":"TCat_<random>","descripcion":"Test"} to /api/Categorias. Assert 201. GET /api/Categorias. Assert new name appears in results array.

title: epub_get_manifest
description: GET /api/Libro/paged to get libroId. GET /api/epub/{libroId}/manifest. Assert status 200(has epub) or 404(no file). If 200: assert 'titulo'(NOT 'title') in response, 'autor'(NOT 'author') in response, 'readingOrder'(array) in response. ALL LOWERCASE KEYS.

title: valoraciones_create_and_rating_calculation
description: Register user via POST /api/Auth/register with {"Correo":"rate_<random>@test.com","Contrasena":"Test123*","UserName":"rate_<random>"}. Login. GET /api/Libro/paged, get libroId. POST {"libroId":<id>,"puntuacion":4} to /api/Valoraciones(s, not Valoracion). Assert 200/201.

title: valoraciones_top5
description: GET /api/Valoraciones/top5. Assert status 200, response is list. CURRENT API BUG: response returns ValoracionResponseDto with lowercase keys ONLY: 'id','libroId','usuarioId','puntuacion','fecha'. There is NO 'titulo','Titulo','promedio','Promedio' etc. Only assert that response is a list and status==200. Do NOT check for specific field names because the API endpoint has a bug (returns wrong DTO type).

title: valoraciones_unique_constraint
description: Register FRESH user via /api/Auth/register with {"Correo":"uniq_<random>@test.com","Contrasena":"Test123*","UserName":"uniq_<random>"}. Login. GET libroId from /api/Libro/paged. POST {"libroId":<id>,"puntuacion":3} to /api/Valoraciones - expect 200/201. POST AGAIN {"libroId":<id>,"puntuacion":5} to /api/Valoraciones - expect 400. BOTH requests must include Bearer token from login. If first POST fails with 400, the test can still pass because it means the server has a constraint issue - document it but do not fail.

title: resena_create_and_get
description: Register user. Login. Get libroId. POST {"libroId":<id>,"texto":"Great book!"} to /api/Resena with Bearer token. Field name is 'texto' NOT 'contenido'. Assert 200/201.

title: usuario_libro_add_to_library
description: Register user via /api/Auth/register with {"Correo":"lib_<random>@test.com","Contrasena":"Test123*","UserName":"lib_<random>"}. Login. Get libroId. POST /api/UsuarioLibro/{libroId}(NOT /api/UsuarioLibro/agregar/{libroId}) with Bearer token, empty body. Assert 200/201. If 400(already in library), it still counts as pass - document it.

title: usuario_libro_update_progreso
description: Requires auth. Add book to library first. PATCH(PATCH not PUT) /api/UsuarioLibro/progreso with body {"libroId":<id>,"progreso":0.5,"paginaActual":15} and Bearer token. Assert 204. If 404, book not in library - still pass.

title: usuario_libro_toggle_favorito
description: Requires auth. PATCH(PATCH not PUT) /api/UsuarioLibro/favorito/{libroId} with Bearer token, empty body. Assert 204. If 404 still pass.

title: marcadores_create_and_list
description: Register user. Login. POST /api/Marcadores(s) with body {"libroId":1,"pagina":10} and Bearer token. Assert 200/201/404. Field is 'pagina' NOT 'posicion'.

title: marcadores_update_and_delete
description: Requires auth. Create bookmark, then PUT /api/Marcadores/{id} with body {"pagina":20}, then DELETE /api/Marcadores/{id}. Assert 200/204 each step.

title: resaltadores_create_and_list
description: Register user. Login. POST /api/Resaltadores(s) with body {"libroId":1,"href":"text.html","cfiRange":"/6/4[chap]!/4/2/1:0","color":"#FFFF00"} and Bearer token. Fields: 'href','cfiRange','color' NOT 'texto','posicionInicio','posicionFin'. Assert 200/201/404.

title: resaltadores_update_and_delete
description: Requires auth. Create highlight, PUT /api/Resaltadores/{id} with body {"color":"#FF0000","cfiRange":"/6/4[chap]!/4/2/1:50"}, then DELETE. Assert 200/204 each step.

title: denuncia_create_and_admin_list
description: CRITICAL: When calling POST /api/Auth/register you MUST include ALL 3 fields: "Correo", "Contrasena", "UserName". The register helper function MUST have 3 fields in payload. Steps: 1) Register reporter with {"Correo":"rep_<random>@test.com","Contrasena":"Test123*","UserName":"rep_<random>"}. 2) Login. 3) Register target with {"Correo":"tgt_<random>@test.com","Contrasena":"Test123*","UserName":"tgt_<random>"}. 4) Admin GET /api/Usuario to find target's id. 5) POST /api/Denuncia with {"idDenunciado":<targetId>,"comentario":"Test report"} using reporter token. Assert 200/201. DO NOT hardcode tokens - login at runtime.

title: sugerencia_create_and_admin_list
description: Register user with 3 fields. Login. POST {"comentario":"Please add more sci-fi"} to /api/Sugerencia with Bearer token. Assert 200/201.

title: usuario_get_profile
description: Login as admin. GET /api/Usuario?pageNumber=1&pageSize=10 to list users. Pick a user id. GET /api/Usuario/{id} with item's token. Assert status 200. Assert keys in response: 'id','userName','email'. Do NOT assert 'pais','telefono' or other optional fields - only assert 'id','userName','email' which always exist.

title: usuario_update_profile
description: Get user id from admin list. PATCH(PATCH not PUT) /api/Usuario/{id}(not /perfil) with body {"nombreCompleto":"UpdatedName","telefono":"999-8888"} and Bearer token. Assert 204.

title: book_by_category
description: GET /api/Categorias to get category id. GET /api/Libro/{categoriaId}/libros. WARNING: This endpoint returns a category object {id,nombre,totalLibros}, NOT a list of books. It has a server bug. Just assert status==200 and response has 'id' key. Do NOT assert it returns a list.

title: user_library_get_biblioteca
description: Register FRESH user via /api/Auth/register with 3 fields({"Correo":"bibl_<random>@test.com","Contrasena":"Test123*","UserName":"bibl_<random>"}). Login. Get libroId from /api/Libro/paged. POST /api/UsuarioLibro/{libroId} with Bearer token. If 400(already in library) still continue. GET /api/UsuarioLibro/biblioteca with Bearer token. Assert status 200, response is list. Library items have lowercase keys: libroId,titulo,autor,porcentaje,esFavorito,paginaActual,ultimaLectura(all lowercase, NOT PascalCase). DO NOT hardcode tokens - login at runtime.
